payload.core_mechanism_summary: Extract run lengths of consecutive 1s from both arrays, sort these lengths, then for each divisor pair (i, j) of k, use binary search and prefix sums to count row intervals of length i and column intervals of length j, multiplying them.
payload.rationale: The solution's core depends on sorting run lengths to enable binary search (bisect_left) for efficient counting of valid interval lengths; no greedy choice is involved, and the counting is combinatorial, making sorting the primary algorithm family.
